name: The Defias Brotherhood
summary: Across Westfall, the Defias Brotherhood moves orders by courier. Gryan Stoutmantle sends the People's Militia after an elusive messenger whose dispatches may reveal how the bandits command their forces.

sections.title: Intercepting the Courier
sections.body: Gryan Stoutmantle's scouts have seen an elusive Defias Messenger traveling between Moonbrook, the Gold Coast Quarry, and the Jangolode Mine. Unlike the thugs who hold the countryside, this courier carries written orders across the region. Stoutmantle wants him captured or killed so the People's Militia can read his satchel and learn where the brotherhood directs its forces.

sections.title: A Trail of Ink
sections.body: The recovered message confirms that Edwin VanCleef, the legendary former leader of the Stonemasons Guild, is personally directing the Defias uprising. It confirms his command over the local cells, but does not reveal where he has made his secret base.

sections.title: A Fortuitous Turn
sections.body: The message confirms VanCleef's leadership, and the People's Militia catches a break. A desperate bandit is caught trying to steal farmer Saldean's wagon and agrees to turn traitor in exchange for his life. With written proof in hand, Stoutmantle shifts his focus to the turncoat, hoping he can lead an escort into the heart of the Defias hideout.

faq.q: Where does the Defias Messenger travel?
faq.answer: The Defias Messenger starts his patrol in Moonbrook, outside the blacksmith shop. He walks north to the Gold Coast Quarry and the Jangolode Mine, enters both underground digs, then retraces his route to Moonbrook.

faq.q: What does the intercepted message reveal?
faq.answer: Stoutmantle hopes the courier's orders will reveal the Brotherhood's command structure and help locate its hideout. The message's contents become known once it is recovered.

Gryan Stoutmantle commands the People's Militia from its headquarters at Sentinel Hill. With too few royal Stormwind guards, he organizes volunteers and adventurers to defend Westfall from Defias raiders.

faq.q: Why is the messenger visiting the mines?
faq.answer: The brotherhood has overrun Westfall's mineral wealth, using the Jangolode Mine and Gold Coast Quarry for raw supplies, shelter, and staging grounds. The messenger carries word between those operations and the Brotherhood's leadership.

faq.q: Does catching the messenger reveal the Defias hideout?
faq.answer: Stoutmantle plans to use the intercepted orders to continue searching for the hideout. You learn the next lead when you return to him.
Edwin VanCleef was Grand Mason of the Stonemasons Guild, which rebuilt Stormwind. Stoutmantle's investigation looks into VanCleef's possible connection to the Brotherhood.

angles.text: Without support from Stormwind's royal garrison, the People's Militia handles Westfall's intelligence on its own, tracking couriers along lonely dirt roads.
As a rogue, you can see how skilled scouts and cutpurses coordinate a sprawling shadow network beneath the militia's nose.
As a human, you can trace the dispatches to Edwin VanCleef and see the bitter, lingering fallout of Stormwind's political and labor disputes.
